description: Loops a segment of a soundfile a specified number of times. Pinned to submode 3 (explicit repeat count). 'extend loop' has three sub-modes; submode 3 is the one with a determinate output duration linear in the repeat count, which makes it the cleanest fit for dry-run duration prediction.
musical_use: Build longer textures from short source fragments. Common pattern for the frog workflow: pick a short region with 'start' and 'len', repeat it 'cnt' times to extend the material, then optionally feed the result into a spectral process. The 'step' flag lets the loop point advance through the infile rather than locking on one segment.

cnt.description: Number of loop repeats required (may be reduced if looping reaches the end of the infile).

start.description: Time in the infile at which the looping process begins.

len.description: Length of the looped segment in milliseconds.

step.description: Advance in the infile from one loopstart to the next, in milliseconds. May be zero in submode 3.

splen.description: Splice (crossfade) length in milliseconds. Default 25 ms.

scat.description: Make the step advance irregular within the timeframe given.

examples.description: Loop a 200 ms slice starting at 0.5 s, 8 repeats, default splice.
examples.expected_use: Extend a short percussive fragment into a steady pulse pattern.

known_issues: The -b flag (play from beginning of infile even if looping doesn't begin there) is not exposed in Phase 1a curated parameters. Phase 1b will add bool-flag support to the schema. To use -b in the meantime, reach for execute().
